rationale: The Linux WebView is no longer linked into the pulp::view umbrella: a target that uses WebViewPanel links pulp::view-webview itself, and missing GTK3 or WebKitGTK development files turn PULP_BUILD_WEBVIEW off with a warning. The touched paths are the core/view CMake, three WebView examples, tests and docs; no design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves.
